definition: f9_grid.run_calm: when the BTC 5m best bid and ask have been unchanged for 1 s (seen +9 ms), BUY 5 post-only one tick BELOW the best bid of the token whose own top-of-book imbalance > 0.3 (UP: (bid size - ask size)/sum; DOWN: the negative); cancel on an ETH/SOL/XRP/DOGE 5m UP-mid move >= 0.5c in 500 ms against that token (+9 +90 ms, never before order-on-book + 90); TTL to 20 s before the close (pick 1) or 30 s (pick 2); one live order per token; hold to settlement; pess queue, dsim fills.
note: the two picks are nearly the same rule (alt pulls end orders long before either TTL); neither had a dev CI lower bound > 0; 2026-11-16 is a re-used holdout (F7i, F8 used it)
